test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A multilateral defence exercise named “Exercise Pitch Black 22” is hosted by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Australia.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• An Indian Air Force (IAF) contingent on 19 August reached Australia to participate in Exercise 'Pitch Black 2022.'
 
• This exercise is scheduled to be held from 19 Aug to 08 Sep 2022 in Australia's Darwin.
 
• It is a biennial, multi-national exercise hosted by the Royal Australian Air Force.
 
• The IAF contingent, led by Group Captain YPS Negi, comprises over 100 air warriors in this exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__A contingent of the Indian Air Force (IAF) left for Malaysia on 12 August 2022 to participate in a bilateral exercise named 'Udarashakti'.

 
• The Indian Air Force is the air arm of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• Its personnel and aircraft assets rank third amongst the air forces of the world.
 
• Its primary mission is to secure Indian airspace and to conduct aerial warfare during armed conflict. 
 
• Indian Air Force (IAF):
 
 
• Founded: 8 October 1932 (as Royal Indian Air Force)
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Chief of the Air Staff: Vivek Ram Chaudhari
 
• Motto: Touch the sky with Glory
